Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez Marry After Decade Together

Football star Cristiano Ronaldo and his long-term partner Georgina Rodriguez have married in Portugal after a decade together. The couple formalized their relationship in a discreet civil ceremony in Cascais. Viral images circulating online, which claimed to show other famous footballers like Lionel Messi at the wedding, have been identified as digitally manipulated or AI-generated.
